latest_release.name: v1.3.10
latest_release.body:
[English](#en-v1.3.10) | [中文](#cn-v1.3.10)

Highlights

- Added **OpenAI Codex subscription access** with device-code sign-in and dynamic model selection, plus a separate **ChatGPT Native OAuth** provider. Native OAuth availability depends on account eligibility; existing Codex sign-in remains independent. - Added **Codex image generation** as a material source. Text and image generation can share the application's Codex login, and generated images support the existing static and slow zoom effects. - Added **Infistar and Jalapeno Cloud** for LLM and video generation, alongside **Runcrate, CloudGPU, and cheapaimodel** LLM providers. - Improved **long-running video generation feedback** with generation stages, elapsed time, and polling status. Task tracking survives page refreshes and temporary query failures, with protection against duplicate submissions. - Simplified **provider settings and selection** in the WebUI, making configured services easier to find and switch between. - Added **Arabic-script subtitle shaping**, including connected letters, right-to-left layout, mixed-script font fallback, and glyph-aware wrapping and backgrounds. - Made **slow image zoom smoother** with sub-pixel rendering, eliminating visible stepping and wobble. - Added Indonesian to script-language choices and refined the Indonesian interface translations. ## Fixes and Improvements - Fixed long Edge TTS narration timing out because of unnecessary delays between streamed chunks. Added support for Edge voices with script subtags and clearer Gemini empty-audio diagnostics. - Removed emoji from narration and burned-in subtitles, and clarified that Gemini and MiMo TTS do not use the voice-speed setting. - Improved subtitle splitting around clock times, full-width numbers, dates, abbreviations, names, and Chinese and Japanese punctuation. Added sentence splitting for Thai and Lao scripts. - Preserved the original timed transcription when subtitle correction cannot align the full script. Fixed empty-string and Unicode length-expansion cases in subtitle similarity scoring. - Preserved combining marks in multilingual social hashtags, excluded emoji marks, and recognized Chinese and Japanese hashtag separators. - Kept existing script and keywords when AI generation fails, displayed an actionable error, and avoided requesting keywords after script generation has already failed. - Preserved the position of repeated topics during script-order stock-material matching, repaired corrupt video caches, and added clearer Pexels and Coverr search-failure logs. - Stopped console keystrokes from prematurely ending or stalling FFmpeg clip concatenation. Fixed render-output synchronization on Windows and big-endian grayscale TIFF brightness. - Improved Windows startup from paths containing special characters, from other working directories, and with LAN listening enabled. Fixed redirected console logs and preserved Windows paths and non-breaking spaces when saving configuration. - Shared Redis task-concurrency limits across workers, with atomic slot reservation, lease renewal, and queued-task recovery. - Improved subtitle-font error messages, API enum defaults, and ChatGPT/Codex sign-in diagnostics. Clarified Docker configuration setup and recovery from an accidentally mounted `config.toml` directory. - Updated CPU-container dependencies to address fixable security findings and added container vulnerability scanning. Expanded regression coverage and corrected Windows-specific path assertions. ## What's Changed - Codex subscription provider — @Hackerprod in [#1715](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/pull/1715). - ChatGPT Native OAuth provider — @Quiyyy in [#1716](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/pull/1716). - Codex image material source — @Hackerprod in [#1719](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/pull/1719). - Infistar LLM and video providers — [ebb0e28](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/commit/
